name: Sweet Potato Besan Pancakes
ingredients: ½ cup cooked mashed sweet potato
steps: Whisk besan with water, cumin, turmeric, ginger, salt and pepper to make a thick batter.
Fold in mashed sweet potato and chopped spinach until evenly combined.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium-low and brush with a little oil.
Spoon batter into four small pancakes and flatten to about 1 cm thick.
Cook 3–4 minutes per side until golden and set in the centre. Serve warm with unsweetened soy yogurt.
note: Make small pancakes so the sweet-potato centre cooks before the outside over-browns.

inspirationReferences.title: Besan Chilla Recipe (Cheela) - Swasthi's Recipes
inspirationReferences.note: Reference for chickpea-flour pancake batter; sweet potato is our variation.
